text: Although this exclusion appears to overlap the claims excluded by the workers' compensation exclusion (¶ 3:314), it also includes claims not covered by workers' compensation; e.g., claims resulting from conduct outside the normal risk of employment (e.g., violent assault, false imprisonment), claims by workers who do not fall within workers' compensation, etc. The exclusion also applies to claims by family members of injured workers. [See CG 00 01 12 07, Sec. 1, Coverage A, ¶ 2.e.] Note: These unusual claims may be covered under “Employers' Liability Insurance” (see ¶ 3:575 ff.). (4) [3:316] Criminal acts: “Personal injury” claims “arising out of a criminal act committed by or at the direction of any insured” are specifically excluded.
